name: devops-control-center
description: Production-grade internal DevOps platform for ~500 users

scripts.dev: docker compose up -d postgres redis api-gateway frontend
scripts.migrate: Get-Content backend/database/schema.sql | docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U devops -d devops_control_center
scripts.seed: Get-Content backend/database/seeds/01_roles.sql | docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U devops -d devops_control_center && Get-Content backend/database/seeds/02_users.sql | docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U devops -d devops_control_center && Get-Content backend/database/seeds/03_widget_types.sql | docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U devops -d devops_control_center && Get-Content backend/database/seeds/04_approval_rules.sql | docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U devops -d devops_control_center && Get-Content backend/database/seeds/05_service_health.sql | docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U devops -d devops_control_center
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres redis && sleep 5 && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:backend: echo 'Python backend linting is configured separately'

author: DevOps Platform Team
